headline: Groww AMC expert explains small-cap vs mid-cap selection

modes.bear: Focusing on individual stock picking may lead to over-concentration or poor selection if the investor lacks deep fundamental research capabilities.
modes.bull: Expert guidance helps investors avoid common pitfalls in volatile small and mid-cap segments, potentially improving long-term portfolio returns.
modes.simple: Small-cap stocks are smaller and riskier than mid-cap stocks. This expert explains why you need to pick individual companies carefully rather than just buying an index fund.

summary: Anupam Tiwari, Head of Equities at Groww Mutual Fund, outlines the fundamental differences between small-cap and mid-cap stock categories. The discussion highlights why individual stock selection is more critical than relying on index performance in these segments. It emphasizes the distinct risk-reward profiles inherent in smaller companies compared to mid-sized firms. Retail investors gain insight into how to approach portfolio construction within these volatile market segments.
why_it_matters: Better understanding of risk when picking small and mid-cap stocks.
